import java.util.*

fun main() {
    val n = readLine()!!.toInt()
    val s = readLine()!!.toString()
    val q = ArrayDeque<Pair<String, Int>>()
    q.add(Pair(s, 0))
    var maxRemovals = 0
    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
        val (current, removals) = q.poll()
        maxRemovals = maxOf(maxRemovals, removals)
        for (i in 0 until current.length) {
            val c = current[i]
            if (c == 'a') continue
            val prevChar = (c - 1).toChar()
            var canRemove = false
            if (i > 0 && current[i - 1] == prevChar) canRemove = true
            if (i < current.length - 1 && current[i + 1] == prevChar) canRemove = true
            if (canRemove) {
                val newStr = current.removeRange(i, i + 1)
                q.add(Pair(newStr, removals + 1))
            }
        }
    }
    println(maxRemovals)
}

                break

        }
        if (!removed) break
    }
    println(count)
}

            val right = if (i < chars.size - 1) chars[i + 1] else null

                chars[i] = ' '
                count++
                removed = true
                break
            }
        }
        if (!removed) break
    }
    println(count)
}

import java.util.*

fun main() {
    val sc = Scanner(System.`in`)
    val n = sc.nextInt()
    val s = sc.next().toCharArray()
    var count = 0
    while (true) {
        var found = false
        for (i in 0 until s.size) {
            if (s[i] == ' ') continue
            val c = s[i]
            if (c == 'a') continue
            val prev = (c - 1).toChar()
            var left = -1
            var right = -1
            // Find left adjacent non-space
            var j = i - 1
            while (j >= 0 && s[j] == ' ') j--
            if (j >= 0) left = j
            // Find right adjacent non-space
            j = i + 1
            while (j < s.size && s[j] == ' ') j++
            if (j < s.size) right = j
            if ((left != -1 && s[left] == prev) || (right != -1 && s[right] == prev)) {
                s[i] = ' '
                count++
                found = true
                break
            }
        }
        if (!found) break
    }
    println(count)
}
